paragraphs: HousingOS is program administration software built for municipal housing teams. The company positions it as a way for housing departments to manage CDBG, HOME, and local rehab funds in one place.

The system follows a case from application intake through construction management, loan servicing and yearly monitoring. Structured workflows guide users through each phase so that nothing is missed. Administrators assign database access based on staff roles. The software also generates email notices, monitoring letters, payoff requests and reconveyances from templates.

A companion online application portal feeds the system, with approved applications importing straight into HousingOS. The company says it builds this site with WCAG and Section 508 accessibility principles in mind. Pricing is quoted agency by agency, on the reasoning that every agency's programs are different.

quote.text: The entire housing program lifecycle, one system
